Senior Backend Engineer, Real-Time Bidding
Axiom Reach — Remote (US)

About the role
Axiom Reach is a programmatic advertising technology company. Our demand-side platform bids on roughly 4 million ad impressions per second across the open exchange, and every bid decision has a 100ms budget end to end.

We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer for the bidder team. This is one of the highest-throughput, lowest-latency systems you will ever work on.

What you'll do
Own components of the real-time bidding path, where p99 latency is measured in single-digit milliseconds
Build the audience segmentation pipeline that turns behavioral event streams into targetable segments
Optimize the bid model serving path for both cost per bid and win rate
Work with the exchange integrations team on OpenRTB protocol compliance across dozens of supply partners

Requirements
6+ years of backend engineering with a focus on high-throughput distributed systems
Deep Go expertise; our entire bidding stack is Go
Production Kafka experience — we process roughly 20TB of event data daily
Strong PostgreSQL and Redis fundamentals
Experience operating on AWS and Kubernetes at scale
Comfort with the operational reality of a system where a 30-second outage is a measurable revenue event

Nice to have
Prior adtech, ad exchange, or real-time bidding experience
OpenRTB, VAST, or related advertising protocol experience
Experience with identity resolution and cross-device graph construction
Terraform, observability tooling, and a strong on-call practice

How we work
Remote-first with an annual company gathering
Strong individual contributor track through Principal
Blameless postmortems and a mature incident practice
